mapper.select: select max(t1.request_time) change_date from sys_if_invoke_outbound t1, sys_if_config_line_b t2 where t1.line_id = t2.line_id and t1.request_status = 'success' and t2.enable_flag = 'Y' and t2.line_code = 'ECIF_CHANGE_QUERY'

select t.bp_record_id, t.oprtn_ind, t.cst_no, t.cst_nm_s, t.ident_no, t.inst_ident_tp, t.unifd_socl_crdt_cd, t.cst_tp, t.ovrs_cst_chin_nm, t.rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd, t.maincorprtnactvctyordstccd, t.cst_lo_natl_std_idy, t.swiftno, t.entp_atch_rltnp, t.ecnm_tp, t.lgl_rprs_nm, t.corprtn_scop1, t.crdt_cst_flg, t.org_cust_type, t.business_date from ws_bp_master_request_records t,ws_document_record_list t1 WHERE t.bp_record_id=t1.source_id and t1.source_table='WS_BP_MASTER_REQUEST_RECORDS'
and t1.outbound_id = #{outboundId}

select t.bp_record_id, h.bp_id, case when h.customer_number is not null then '2' else '1' end oprtn_ind,--操作标识 h.customer_number as cst_no,--总行客户号 h.bp_name as cst_nm_s,--客户名称 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='BP.REGISTRATION_NUM_TYPE' and v.code_value=h.registration_num_type)as inst_ident_tp,--机构证件类型 h.register_cert_num as ident_no,--证件号码 case when h.registration_num_type='07' then h.register_cert_num else null end unifd_socl_crdt_cd,--统一社会信用代码 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='HLS.CUSTOMER_TYPE' and v.code_value=h.head_office_bp_type)as cst_tp,--客户类型 h.overseas_customer_name as ovrs_cst_chin_nm,--境外客户中文名称 (select fc.digital_code from hls_bp_master_address hd,fnd_country fc where hd.bp_id=h.bp_id and hd.address_type='REGISTERED_ADDRESS' and fc.country=hd.country)rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd,--国家和地区代码 (select fc.digital_code from fnd_country fc where fc.country=h.business_area)maincorprtnactvctyordstccd,--主要经营活动所在国家/地区 (select hsc.class_code from hls_stat_class hsc where hsc.class_id=h.economic_indu_classify)as cst_lo_natl_std_idy, --客户所属国标行业 h.swift as swiftno,--SWIFT BIC h.enterprise_affiliation as entp_atch_rltnp,--企业隶属关系 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='ZX_ECONOMICTYPE' and v.code_value=h.bp_financial_type)as ecnm_tp,--经济类型 h.legal_person as lgl_rprs_nm,--法定代表人/经营者名称 h.business_scope as corprtn_scop1,--经营范围 case when nvl(h.credit_customer,'N')='Y' then '1' else '0' end crdt_cst_flg,--信用客户标志 h.bp_type as org_cust_type,--机构客户类型 h.is_first_success, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=h.created_by)operator, h.last_update_date update_date, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=h.last_updated_by)last_updated_te, 'H00A98核心' as update_source, 'H00A98核心' as data_source, h.creation_date ecif_create_date from hls_bp_master h,ws_bp_master_request_records t,ws_document_record_list t1 where t.bp_record_id=t1.source_id and t1.source_table='WS_BP_MASTER_REQUEST_RECORDS' and h.bp_id=t.bp_id
and t1.outbound_id = #{outboundId}

select h.bp_id, case when h.customer_number is not null then '2' else '1' end oprtn_ind,--操作标识 h.customer_number as cst_no,--总行客户号 h.bp_name as cst_nm_s,--客户名称 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='BP.REGISTRATION_NUM_TYPE' and v.code_value=h.registration_num_type)as inst_ident_tp,--机构证件类型 h.register_cert_num as ident_no,--证件号码 case when h.registration_num_type='07' then h.register_cert_num else null end unifd_socl_crdt_cd,--统一社会信用代码 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='HLS.CUSTOMER_TYPE' and v.code_value=h.head_office_bp_type)as cst_tp,--客户类型 h.overseas_customer_name as ovrs_cst_chin_nm,--境外客户中文名称 (select fc.digital_code from hls_bp_master_address hd,fnd_country fc where hd.bp_id=h.bp_id and hd.address_type='REGISTERED_ADDRESS' and fc.country=hd.country)rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd,--国家和地区代码 (select fc.digital_code from fnd_country fc where fc.country=h.business_area)maincorprtnactvctyordstccd,--主要经营活动所在国家/地区 (select hsc.class_code from hls_stat_class hsc where hsc.class_id=h.economic_indu_classify)as cst_lo_natl_std_idy, --客户所属国标行业 h.swift as swiftno,--SWIFT BIC h.enterprise_affiliation as entp_atch_rltnp,--企业隶属关系 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='ZX_ECONOMICTYPE' and v.code_value=h.bp_financial_type)as ecnm_tp,--经济类型 h.legal_person as lgl_rprs_nm,--法定代表人/经营者名称 h.business_scope as corprtn_scop1,--经营范围 case when nvl(h.credit_customer,'N')='Y' then '1' else '0' end crdt_cst_flg,--信用客户标志 h.bp_type as org_cust_type,--机构客户类型 h.is_first_success, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=h.created_by)operator, h.last_update_date update_date, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=h.last_updated_by)last_updated_te, 'H00A98核心' as update_source, 'H00A98核心' as data_source, h.creation_date ecif_create_date from hls_bp_master h where 1=1
and h.bp_id = #{bpId}

select wb.cst_no, wb.cst_nm_s, wb.ident_no, wb.inst_ident_tp, --
case when wb.inst_ident_tp='1' THEN '07' ELSE (select v.code_value from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'BP.REGISTRATION_NUM_TYPE' and v.attribute1 = wb.inst_ident_tp) end inst_ident_tp_c, --机构证件类型
case when wb.inst_ident_tp='1' THEN '统一社会信用代码' else (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'BP.REGISTRATION_NUM_TYPE' and v.attribute1 = wb.inst_ident_tp) end inst_ident_tp_n, --机构证件类型
wb.unifd_socl_crdt_cd, -- (select h.bp_id from hls_bp_master h where h.registration_num_type=wb.inst_ident_tp and h.register_cert_num=wb.ident_no and rownum=1)bp_id, wb.cst_tp, -- (select v.code_value from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'HLS.CUSTOMER_TYPE' and v.attribute1 = wb.cst_tp) as cst_tp_c, --客户类型 (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'HLS.CUSTOMER_TYPE' and v.attribute1 = wb.cst_tp) as cst_tp_n, --客户类型 wb.ovrs_cst_chin_nm,
(select h.overseas_customer_name from hls_bp_master h where h.customer_number=wb.cst_no and rownum=1) before_ovrs_cst_chin_nm,
wb.rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd, (select fc.country from fnd_country fc where fc.digital_code = wb.rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd) rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd_c, --国家和地区代码 (select fc.country_name from fnd_country fc where fc.digital_code = wb.rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd) rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd_n, --国家和地区代码 wb.maincorprtnactvctyordstccd, -- (select fc.country from fnd_country fc where fc.digital_code = wb.maincorprtnactvctyordstccd) maincorprtnactvctyordstccd_c, --主要经营活动所在国家/地区 (select fc.country_name from fnd_country fc where fc.digital_code = wb.maincorprtnactvctyordstccd) maincorprtnactvctyordstccd_n, --主要经营活动所在国家/地区 wb.cst_lo_natl_std_idy,
(select hsc.class_id from hls_stat_class hsc where hsc.class_code=wb.cst_lo_natl_std_idy)cst_lo_natl_std_idy_c, --客户所属国标行业 (select hsc.description from hls_stat_class hsc where hsc.class_code=wb.cst_lo_natl_std_idy)cst_lo_natl_std_idy_n, --客户所属国标行业
(select h.economic_indu_classify from hls_bp_master h where h.customer_number=wb.cst_noand rownum=1) before_cst_lo_natl_std_idy,
wb.swiftno, (select h.swift from hls_bp_master h where h.customer_number=wb.cst_no and rownum=1) before_swiftno,
wb.entp_atch_rltnp, wb.entp_atch_rltnp as entp_atch_rltnp_c, --企业隶属关系 (select v.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'HLS.ENTERPRISE_AFFILIATION' and v.code_value = wb.entp_atch_rltnp) as entp_atch_rltnp_n, --企业隶属关系 wb.ecnm_tp, (select v.code_value from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'ZX_ECONOMICTYPE' and v.ATTRIBUTE1 = wb.ecnm_tp) as ecnm_tp_c, --经济类型 (select v.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'ZX_ECONOMICTYPE' and v.ATTRIBUTE1 = wb.ecnm_tp) as ecnm_tp_n, --经济类型
wb.lgl_rprs_nm, wb.corprtn_scop1, wb.crdt_cst_flg, -- case when wb.crdt_cst_flg = '1' then 'Y' else 'N' end crdt_cst_flg_c, --信用客户标志 case when wb.crdt_cst_flg = '1' then '是' else '否' end crdt_cst_flg_n, --信用客户标志
wb.org_cust_type, -- wb.org_cust_type as org_cust_type_c, (select hbt.description from hls_bp_type hbt where hbt.bp_type = wb.org_cust_type) org_cust_type_n, wb.business_date from ws_bp_master_request_records wb
where 1=1
and wb.bp_record_id = #{bpRecordId}

select h.bp_id, case when h.customer_number is not null then '2' else '1' end oprtn_ind, --操作标识 h.customer_number as cst_no, --总行客户号 h.bp_name as cst_nm_s, --客户名称 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE='BP.REGISTRATION_NUM_TYPE' and v.code_value=h.registration_num_type)as inst_ident_tp,--机构证件类型 h.register_cert_num as ident_no, --证件号码 case when h.registration_num_type = '07' then h.register_cert_num else null end unifd_socl_crdt_cd, --统一社会信用代码 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'HLS.CUSTOMER_TYPE' and v.code_value = h.head_office_bp_type) as cst_tp, --客户类型 h.overseas_customer_name as ovrs_cst_chin_nm, --境外客户中文名称 (select fc.digital_code from hls_bp_master_address hd, fnd_country fc where hd.bp_id = h.bp_id and hd.address_type = 'REGISTERED_ADDRESS' and fc.country = hd.country) rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd, --国家和地区代码 (select fc.digital_code from fnd_country fc where fc.country=h.business_area)maincorprtnactvctyordstccd,--主要经营活动所在国家/地区 (select hsc.class_code from hls_stat_class hsc where hsc.class_id=h.economic_indu_classify)as cst_lo_natl_std_idy, --客户所属国标行业 h.swift as swiftno, --SWIFT BIC h.enterprise_affiliation as entp_atch_rltnp, --企业隶属关系 (select v.ATTRIBUTE1 from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.CODE = 'ZX_ECONOMICTYPE' and v.code_value = h.bp_financial_type) as ecnm_tp, --经济类型 h.legal_person as lgl_rprs_nm, --法定代表人/经营者名称 h.business_scope as corprtn_scop1, --经营范围 case when h.credit_customer = 'Y' then '1' else '0' end crdt_cst_flg, --信用客户标志 h.bp_type as org_cust_type, --机构客户类型 h.is_first_success, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=h.created_by)operator, h.last_update_date update_date, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=h.last_updated_by)last_updated_te, 'H00A98核心' as update_source, 'H00A98核心' as data_source, h.creation_date ecif_create_date from prj_project_bp t1, hls_bp_master h where t1.bp_id = h.bp_id and t1.bp_categroy = 'PRJ_PROJECT' and t1.bp_type in ('TENANT_SEC', 'TENANT', 'WARRANTOR') and h.bp_class = 'ORG' and nvl(h.is_first_success,'N')='N'
and t1.project_id = #{projectId}
